jamie_eng: quick Q — my role is moving to a restricted state and the plan vendor told me contributions might be paused during the transition. If my payroll moves to a different state mid-year, does that affect 401k deferrals or employer match?

real_benefits: hey @jamie_eng :wave: generally moving payroll/state doesn't change plan eligibility immediately. Employer match follows payroll-eligible compensation. If payroll processing shifts and there's a gap in pay, missed deferrals won't generate match. We'll coordinate with payroll to avoid gaps.

carol_payroll: adding ops detail — if payroll changes vendors there may be a payroll blackout window (usually 1 pay period). During blackout you might have a net pay but deferred contributions could fail depending on timing. If you anticipate a blackout, tell us now so we can plan an off-cycle deferral or vendor one-time contribution request after the fact.

jamie_eng: ok, thanks. I also have a small outstanding 401k loan. If there's a pay blackout, will loan payments stop? Could that trigger a distribution?

carol_payroll: loan repayments are payroll-based. If no payroll withholding, you must set up ACH with the plan vendor to continue payments. If payments stop and remain unpaid, they can be treated as a distribution and be taxable. We can help set up ACH — DM me.

forus-rep: Forus here — we support processing one-time contributions and ACH loan payments for cases like vendor migrations. For missed deferrals, plan admin approval is required to accept after-the-fact employee deferrals. Provide participant ID, dates, and amounts. Send forms to transfers@forus.example.

jamie_eng: great. Last thing: any impact on Roth in-plan conversions if there's a mid-year payroll vendor switch? I was going to convert some after-tax amounts to Roth.

real_benefits: conversions are processed on the plan level, so a payroll vendor switch shouldn't prevent a conversion as long as the account and balances are accessible. Timing is key — avoid scheduling conversions during a known blackout. We'll coordinate with Forus and payroll to pick safe dates.

benefits-bot: Helpful: https://benefits.redwood.example/payroll-migrations (see "Blackouts, Loans & Catch-up Contributions")

jamie_eng: thanks all — I'll DM Carol my expected move date and the loan details so we can set up ACH if needed. Appreciate it!
